snippet.title: Killing Things With Your Friends - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Rip limbs off mutants and use them as weapons in this chaotic co-op survival game about dark humour and dismemberment. Hack through mutant hordes, work as a team, and survive lethal challenges for profit!
